text.en: On Windows you can also uninstall via Settings > Apps, or run the matching python.org installer with /uninstall. On Linux, deadsnakes/dnf installs leave python3.x as a versioned binary that does not replace the system interpreter.

args: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl

elevationReason.zh: 通过 apt 安装系统包。

title.zh: 添加 Docker 官方 GPG 密钥

args: sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && sudo curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc && sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc

elevationReason.en: Writes the repository signing key to system keyring directory.
elevationReason.zh: 将仓库签名密钥写入系统密钥环目录。

title.zh: 添加 Docker apt 仓库

args: echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo "${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-$VERSION_CODENAME}") stable" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null && sudo apt-get update

elevationReason.en: Adds a system apt source and refreshes package indexes.
elevationReason.zh: 添加系统 apt 源并刷新包索引。

title.zh: 安装 Docker Engine 包

args: sudo apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
